6786.title: Compaction admission chooses a thread-wide event index
6786.rootCauseOneLine: The synchronous compaction lifecycle lookup uses a thread-only ordering index, scanning old events when the current turn has no compaction.

prReviews.topFinding: Forces the existing turn-selective index; its branch was not executed.

6786.proposedFix: Use a deterministic turn-bounded lifecycle lookup and keep query-plan regression coverage; existing linked PR #6787 already targets this cause.
6786.caveats: No production database, HTTP send, cold-cache trial or multi-second wall-time measurement. Reproduction patch and measured output are inline under reports repository policy.
